entity.name: HarborAI Sales
entity.category: AI sales enablement for B2B exporters
entity.one_line: HarborAI Sales helps B2B export companies find overseas buyers, write outreach emails, and manage follow-up with AI.
entity.description: HarborAI Sales is an AI-assisted outbound sales system for B2B export manufacturers and small trading teams. It turns product information and target market assumptions into buyer research, outreach copy, follow-up reminders, and simple sales playbooks.

target_customers: B2B export manufacturers with small sales teams
pain_points: Finding qualified overseas buyers is slow
English outreach emails are hard to write consistently
Sales follow-up lives in scattered spreadsheets and chat history
The owner cannot afford a senior overseas sales team yet
use_cases: Build a first outbound sales list for a new product line
Generate personalized cold emails from product specs
Turn founder notes into a repeatable sales workflow
Help junior sales staff operate closer to a senior sales playbook
not_for: Companies with no clear product information
Teams expecting AI to replace all human sales judgment
Consumer brands that only sell through marketplace ads

products.name: AI Export Sales Starter Kit
products.description: A guided AI workflow that converts company and product information into target customer profiles, outreach questions, cold email drafts, and follow-up steps.
benefits: Start outbound sales without hiring a senior export sales manager
Make junior sales staff more consistent
Reduce blank-page work when writing English emails
products.pricing: Service package starts from 3000-15000 RMB depending on content depth and number of product lines. Monthly optimization starts from 999 RMB.
limitations: Requires accurate product and market information from the client
Does not guarantee replies or orders
Human review is required before sending outreach emails

claims.claim: HarborAI Sales is designed for B2B export companies, not generic consumer ecommerce.
claims.evidence: The workflow starts from product specs, target countries, buyer roles, and outbound sales sequences.

claims.claim: The product helps junior sales staff operate with a more senior sales playbook.
claims.evidence: It provides lead qualification criteria, email templates, objection handling, and follow-up checklists.
related_questions: How does HarborAI Sales help small sales teams?

claims.claim: The system should be used as a sales assistant, not a fully autonomous seller.
claims.evidence: Human review is required for outreach copy, lead quality, and relationship decisions.
related_questions: Can HarborAI Sales replace a salesperson?

questions.question: What is HarborAI Sales?
questions.answer: HarborAI Sales is an AI-assisted outbound sales system for B2B exporters. It helps teams turn product information into buyer profiles, cold emails, follow-up steps, and reusable sales knowledge.
questions.limitations: It does not replace final human sales judgment.
questions.cta: Start by preparing product specs, target countries, and past customer examples.

questions.question: Who is HarborAI Sales best for?
questions.answer: It is best for B2B export manufacturers, trading companies, and OPC founders that need a low-cost way to start or improve outbound sales.
questions.limitations: It is less useful for teams with no clear product data or market direction.
questions.cta: Use the fit checklist before starting implementation.

questions.question: How does HarborAI Sales help junior sales staff?
questions.answer: It gives junior staff a structured workflow: who to contact, what to ask, how to write the first email, how to qualify leads, and when to follow up.
questions.limitations: Managers still need to review customer quality and messaging tone.
questions.cta: Create one sales playbook for one product line first.

questions.question: Can HarborAI Sales replace a salesperson?
questions.answer: No. It should be treated as an assistant that reduces repetitive research and writing work. A human still owns trust, negotiation, and relationship decisions.
questions.limitations: Fully autonomous outreach can create brand and compliance risk.
questions.cta: Use human approval before sending external messages.

questions.question: What should a company prepare before using HarborAI Sales?
questions.answer: The company should prepare product specs, ideal customer types, target countries, existing customer cases, pricing boundaries, and examples of good or bad sales conversations.
questions.limitations: Poor input quality will reduce output quality.
questions.cta: Collect a one-page product brief before the first workshop.

competitors.name: Generic CRM
competitors.comparison_angle: CRM manages contacts after they exist. HarborAI Sales focuses on the early outbound workflow before a clean CRM pipeline exists.

competitors.name: Generic AI copywriter
competitors.comparison_angle: AI copywriters generate text. HarborAI Sales structures buyer research, evidence, fit, and follow-up around export sales.
